claims: T.J. Otzelberger is the head men's basketball coach at Iowa State University.
T.J. Otzelberger has held the position since March 2021.
T.J. Otzelberger was hired on March 18, 2021.
T.J. Otzelberger was hired as the 21st head coach in Iowa State University men's basketball program history.
T.J. Otzelberger led the Iowa State Cyclones to a Sweet 16 appearance in 2022.
T.J. Otzelberger led the Iowa State Cyclones to a Sweet 16 appearance in 2024.
As of March 2026, T.J. Otzelberger has led the Iowa State University men's basketball team to over 90 wins in his first four years.
As of March 2026, T.J. Otzelberger's over 90 wins in his first four years is the most in Iowa State University school history for that span.
Before joining Iowa State University, T.J. Otzelberger was the head coach at South Dakota State.
T.J. Otzelberger had previous assistant coaching roles at Iowa State University under Greg McDermott.
T.J. Otzelberger had previous assistant coaching roles at Iowa State University under Fred Hoiberg.
T.J. Otzelberger had previous assistant coaching roles at Iowa State University under Steve Prohm.
T.J. Otzelberger is currently leading the Iowa State Cyclones in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
